clips.title: The story
paras: Me Brother, Nipsy is an Alliance delivery quest that takes travelers across the Deeprun Tram between Ironforge and Stormwind. A gnome named Monty tasks commuters with transporting a crate of live rats to his brother Nipsy, who runs a rat kabob stall at the opposite terminal. Beneath the quirky errand lies a touching look at Monty's fractured mind following the tragedy of Gnomeregan.

Me Brother, Nipsy is a brief courier errand that introduces commuters to the wonders—and hazards—of the Deeprun Tram. Stationed on the Ironforge side of the tramway, an odd gnome named Monty tasks travelers with ferrying a carton of fresh critters through the subterranean transit corridor to his brother Nipsy at the Stormwind depot. The delivery highlights the bizarre everyday commerce taking place beneath the mountains connecting the dwarven and human capitals.

While labeled as a Carton of Mystery Meat, the parcel is actually packed with live, squirming Deeprun rats. Nipsy operates a rat kabob enterprise at the Stormwind terminal and requires his stock delivered before it goes bad. When the crate arrives intact and twitching, Nipsy is relieved to keep his culinary operation stocked for hungry travelers passing through the transit hub.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Me brother, Nipsy, runs a rat kabob operation on the other side of Deeprun. Ye needs to take this here crate o' rats to him before they go bad. Get a move on!
Ye have ridden a tram before, aye? It's easy. Just step aboard when she arrives and enjoy the ride. An' keep yer arms and legs inside durin' the ride, lest ye be peglegged fer life.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.
Alive and kicking... And just in time!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Poor Monty. Ever since the Gnomeregan incident, he hasn't been the same. That boy has never seen an ocean in his life, let alone being some kind of pirate.
At least he keeps the flow of twitching critters coming.
